name: motion-motif-still-while-paused
why: The animation timer stops while paused; the motif must still be drawn (a still frame), not left blank.

name: motion-off-still-frame
why: motion off: no timer at all, but the motif and stage equaliser still show a still frame.

name: motion-equaliser-bars-have-gaps
why: The equaliser draws one-cell bars with a gap between, never a solid block.

name: motion-progress-head-eighths
why: The blocks progress style ends in an eighth-block cell, so the head creeps instead of jumping a whole cell.
